measurement_notes: Authorized selected-model benchmark or bundled synthetic validation. Benchmark mode uses deterministic FP32 tensor inputs; it does not represent actual gameplay preprocessing/inference. CPU baseline is cross-provider agreement, not independent model correctness.  ONNX Run wall latency includes transfers, execution and output materialization; output validation and setup excluded from mean Run latency. Validated-loop inference FPS includes periodic numerical checking.  Serial inference/s is reciprocal mean Run latency, not display FPS. CUDA event duration measures the vector-add kernel, not inference. CUDA EP marked verified only with numeric agreement, disabled CPU fallback and a CUDAExecutionProvider node in actual ORT profiling. Render FPS is reciprocal of observed main-window frame intervals during each phase; short phases can have too few frames to compare. Process GPU busy is PDH busiest matching PID+adapter engine; local VRAM is per-process DXGI WDDM usage. Counters sampled at 2Hz can miss short peaks. Memory endpoints/ranges do not establish leak freedom.
model: Actual selected ONNX file, deterministic FP32 inputs, CPU-reference comparison
